people.title: People
people.intro: CRGD is governed by a board, advised by people who have spent their working lives in public institutions, and run by a team of researchers, fellows and interns. Every one of them is listed here, with the work they have done for CRGD.

categories.label: Governing Board
categories.description: The Governing Board holds final responsibility for CRGD's direction, finances and integrity. It approves the annual plan and budget, appoints the leadership and safeguards the independence of research.

categories.label: Advisory Board
categories.description: Senior practitioners and scholars who advise on research priorities, review the quality of major studies and open doors to the institutions CRGD seeks to inform. Advisers serve in a personal capacity.

categories.label: Scholars
categories.description: Academics and senior researchers who lead or anchor work in one or more of CRGD's research verticals.

categories.label: Mentors
categories.description: Experienced professionals who guide CRGD's fellows, interns and campus clubs, one conversation at a time.

categories.label: Team
categories.description: The associates, fellows, researchers, interns and contributors who do the daily work of research, writing, outreach and events.

categories.label: Patrons
categories.description: Individuals whose support and standing have helped CRGD establish itself. Patrons do not direct research.

research.title: Research verticals and centres
research.intro: CRGD's research is organised into eighteen verticals. Each one asks a small number of hard questions about how Kerala and India are governed, and answers them with data, field work and comparison. The verticals talk to each other: few real policy problems stay inside one subject.

learning.title: Learning at CRGD
learning.intro: Good policy needs people who can read a budget, question a dataset and write a clear note to a minister. The CRGD Academy and its dialogues, colloquia and academic programs exist to build those skills in students, public servants, journalists and citizens.

categories.label: CRGD Academy
categories.description: The CRGD Academy is the teaching arm of CRGD. It runs certificate programs, short courses and workshops in public policy, taught by practitioners and researchers, with an emphasis on doing rather than memorising.

categories.label: Courses
categories.description: Short, structured courses on specific skills and subjects: public finance, policy writing, data for governance, and more. Most run online on weekday evenings, so working people can take them.

categories.label: Dialogue
categories.description: Dialogues bring people who disagree into the same room under rules that let them speak plainly. They are small, prepared in advance and followed by a written note of what was learned.

categories.label: Academic Programs
categories.description: Programs designed with universities and colleges: credit bearing electives, faculty development, dissertation supervision and field placements in policy research.

categories.label: Collaborations
categories.description: Joint research, teaching and events with universities, research institutions, civil society organisations and public bodies, in India and abroad.

categories.label: Colloquium
categories.description: A regular forum where researchers present work in progress to a critical audience before it is published. Open to scholars and students; papers are circulated a week in advance.

programs.title: Programs
programs.intro: CRGD's programs are how new people enter public policy. Fellows take on a full research project, interns work alongside researchers, coordinators carry CRGD's work into their colleges and districts, and campus clubs make policy a subject students argue about.

categories.label: Fellowships
categories.description: Fellowships are full time or part time research positions of six to twelve months. Fellows design and complete a policy research project under supervision, publish their findings and present them to people who can act on them.

categories.label: Internships
categories.description: Internships of four to twelve weeks for students and recent graduates. Interns join a research vertical, work on live projects and finish with an internship report that CRGD publishes when it meets the standard.

categories.label: Co-ordinator Program
categories.description: Coordinators represent CRGD in their college, university or district. They organise events, gather local evidence, recruit club members and connect their communities with CRGD's research.

categories.label: Campus Clubs
categories.description: CRGD Policy Clubs are student led groups in colleges and universities. They read, debate and write about public policy, run mock legislatures and budget simulations, and contribute to the Young Thoughts series.

publications.title: Publications
publications.intro: CRGD publishes research, analysis, commentary and more across sixteen categories, each serving a distinct intellectual and public purpose. Filter by type, research vertical or year, or search titles, summaries, authors and topics.

categories.label: Policy Briefs
categories.description: Concise, evidence-based assessments of specific policy problems, accompanied by actionable recommendations.

categories.label: Long Form
categories.description: Extended essays exploring complex political, economic, social and institutional questions in depth.

categories.label: Policy Reports
categories.description: Comprehensive research publications examining policy frameworks, institutional performance and reform alternatives.

categories.label: Analysis
categories.description: Structured, evidence-led examinations of contemporary developments, policy decisions, emerging trends and their wider implications.

categories.label: Special Reports
categories.description: Focused investigations and thematic studies addressing issues of exceptional public or institutional significance.

categories.label: Commentary
categories.description: Interpretative perspectives on contemporary affairs, public institutions and policy debates.

categories.label: Explainers
categories.description: Accessible, factually grounded examinations of complex concepts, issues, legislation, institutions and policy developments.

categories.label: Opinion
categories.description: Clearly articulated arguments presenting original perspectives on matters of public interest.

categories.label: Blogs
categories.description: Concise reflections, observations and discussions exploring emerging issues, experiences and ideas.

categories.label: Young Thoughts
categories.description: A dedicated platform for students and emerging thinkers to contribute original ideas, critical reflections and informed perspectives.

categories.label: Expert View
categories.description: Specialist contributions from scholars, practitioners and professionals drawing upon recognised expertise and experience.

categories.label: Reviews
categories.description: Critical assessments of publications, policies, intellectual contributions and other works of public or academic significance.

categories.label: Books & Journals
categories.description: Scholarly discussions, reviews and assessments of books, academic journals and significant research literature.

categories.label: Internship/Fellowship Reports
categories.description: Selected research outputs, field observations and analytical reports developed through CRGD's internship/fellowship programmes.

categories.label: Podcasts
categories.description: Recorded conversations, interviews and discussions examining ideas, institutions and contemporary policy questions.

categories.label: Videos
categories.description: Interviews, lectures, explainers, discussions and other audiovisual contributions to public knowledge.

impact.title: Impact
impact.intro: Research matters when it changes something: a rule, a budget line, a public conversation, the way an office works. This section records what CRGD has set out to change, what it is working on now, what has been achieved and the recognition that has followed.

categories.label: Advocacy
categories.description: Sustained, evidence based efforts to change a specific policy or practice, carried out openly and on the record.

categories.label: Ongoing
categories.description: Projects and engagements that are under way, with their objectives, partners and current status.

categories.label: Accomplished
categories.description: Completed projects and the results they produced, stated as precisely as the evidence allows.

categories.label: Awards & Honours
categories.description: Recognition received by CRGD and its people for their work.

events.title: Events
events.intro: CRGD convenes lectures, roundtables, workshops and conferences in Thiruvananthapuram, across Kerala and online. Most events are free and open to the public. Recordings and written summaries are published afterwards.

media.title: Media centre
media.intro: Official statements, interviews, speeches, photographs and coverage of CRGD's work. Journalists can reach the media team directly for comment, data or interviews with our researchers.

categories.label: Press Releases
categories.description: Official statements and announcements from CRGD.

categories.label: Photographs
categories.description: Photographs from CRGD events, field work and programs. Images may be used by the press with credit to CRGD.

categories.label: Interviews
categories.description: Interviews given by CRGD's people to newspapers, television, radio and digital media.

categories.label: Speeches
categories.description: Texts and recordings of speeches and lectures delivered by CRGD's leadership and researchers.

categories.label: Archives
categories.description: Older material from CRGD's history: early statements, event records and documents preserved for reference.

categories.label: CRGD in News
categories.description: News coverage of CRGD's research, events and people.

categories.label: Mentions
categories.description: Places where CRGD's work has been cited or referred to: in the press, in legislatures, in official documents and in academic writing.

careers.title: Careers at CRGD
careers.intro: CRGD hires people who are curious, careful with evidence and able to write clearly for readers who are busy. Current openings are listed below, along with fellowships and internships for those earlier in their careers.

annualReports.title: Annual Reports
annualReports.intro: Each year CRGD publishes an account of what it did, what it spent and what it learned, including a summary of its finances and its sources of funding.

locations.title: Location
locations.intro: CRGD works from its headquarters in Thiruvananthapuram, close to the Government Secretariat. Regional centres are planned so that the institution can be closer to the places it studies.

updates.title: Latest updates
updates.intro: Announcements, calls for applications and news from CRGD.
